_comment: SM6250 (miatoll). Every value is a COPY of sweet/SM7150 unless 'verified' is true. Fill from the stock boot.img DTB (tools/unpack_bootv2.py) and the live FDT, then flip verified.
name: miatoll

high_phys_base.note: check memory node; SM6250 phones are 4/6/8 GB, bank layout may differ

high_mem_size.note: live FDT (curtana 6GB): banks 0x80000000+0x3dd00000, 0x100000000+0x80000000, 0xc0000000+0x40000000. sweet's 0xfcc00000 would overrun this bank

ufs.note: ufshc@1d84000 on sm6250 mainline; eMMC variants need an SDHCI driver instead

cpus.note: SM6250: 2x A76 + 6x A55; check MPIDR Aff1/Aff2 layout in the FDT cpu nodes

touch.note: FocalTech fts / Novatek NT36xxx over SPI, NOT Goodix I2C: patches 0060/0063 need a new driver
